# SmugMug

SmugMug is a platform for photographers to showcase, share, and sell their photos and videos.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/smugmug/.

## Actions

- **Get Folder Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves the details of a specific folder for a smugmug user using its node id.
- **Get Node Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves the details for a specific node (e.g., album, folder, page) using its unique nodeid.
- **Get User Profile** (read-only): Retrieves the public profile information for a smugmug user.
- **List Albums in Folder** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all albums within a specified user's folder on smugmug.
- **List Child Nodes** (read-only): Retrieves a list of all child nodes (albums or folders) for a specified parent node in smugmug.
